importMode: Full source join with exact-ID astrophysical radius enrichment

distanceKind.0: Unknown; retain angular position without a fabricated distance
distanceKind.1: GSP-Phot model-derived posterior distance (pc), not direct measurement

limitations: This fixed-release catalogue contains candidate solar-like rotational variables, not every star.
The period is inferred from photometric rotational modulation; no resolved surface map or spin-axis orientation is supplied.
GSP-Phot radii, temperatures and distances are model-derived catalog values; their accuracy depends on source quality and the model assumptions.
Reciprocal-parallax fallback is a simple estimate at high signal-to-noise, not a full Bayesian distance posterior.
No radius, distance, surface texture or axial tilt is invented for a missing value.
Hipparcos crossmatch is used for identity deduplication; Gaia coordinates are at J2016.0, whereas HYG positions use a different reference epoch.

sources.query:
SELECT r.source_id,s.ra,s.dec,s.parallax,s.parallax_error,
s.phot_g_mean_mag,s.bp_rp,r.best_rotation_period,r.best_rotation_period_error,
s.teff_gspphot,s.distance_gspphot
FROM gaiadr3.vari_rotation_modulation r
JOIN gaiadr3.gaia_source s ON r.source_id=s.source_id
sources.hipparcosQuery:
SELECT r.source_id,h.original_ext_source_id,h.angular_distance
FROM gaiadr3.vari_rotation_modulation r
JOIN gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour h ON r.source_id=h.source_id
sources.radiusQuery:
SELECT r.source_id,p.radius_gspphot
FROM gaiadr3.vari_rotation_modulation r
JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters p ON r.source_id=p.source_id
WHERE p.radius_gspphot IS NOT NULL

binary.precision: Source IDs exact uint64; astrometry float64; other numeric parameters float32 (~7 significant digits). JSON preserves the audit representation.
